title: Projective Maps from the Perspective of Elliptic Differential Operators
summary: This paper develops an analytical approach to the study of the geometry of projective maps using the theory of elliptic differential operators. We construct two elliptic operators of second and fourth order, whose kernels characterize projective diffeomorphisms between Riemannian manifolds and one-parameter groups of projective diffeomorphisms (transformations) of a Riemannian manifold onto itself, respectively.
